summary: Codemasters Evo's 2018 team-based arcade vehicular-combat racer, built around boost, takedowns, team objectives, and pack-respawn systems rather than finish-line racing.

entries.title: Onrush

emulation.emulator: Original Xbox One-family or PS4 hardware
emulation.notes: Use owned console copies for offline content; online team modes are not preserved through official servers.

primary.why: Onrush released on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One; an announced Windows version did not ship, online servers shut down on 30 November 2022, and digital console versions were delisted. With no PC version and no sourced platform-exclusive content, Xbox One is the practical primary console-family route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Xbox One copy on compatible Xbox hardware for offline/single-player preservation; do not rely on online server functionality.

all_releases.fidelity: HD console release; practical route through owned Xbox One-family access.
all_releases.reason: primary: chosen console-family route because no PC version shipped and no sourced PS4-exclusive content exists.
skip: equivalent console route and no sourced content advantage over Xbox One.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary route; online functionality is no longer available after the server shutdown.

entries.remaster_caveats: Windows was announced but not released; online servers officially shut down on 30 November 2022, and digital console versions were delisted.
